integrity: The complete analytic proof and a supplementary standalone symbolic/numerical checker are provided. Finite experiments do not constitute an infinite proof.
scientific_limitations: Exact intrinsic S^3 geodesic kernel only, a>0 and the specified cosine order; no general higher-dimensional or higher-harmonic classification. Bibliographic comparison is bounded; independent assessment has not been performed.
title: A two-sided positivity cone and every-mode staircase for geodesic exponentials on \(\mathbb S^3\)
